headline.title: A total solar eclipse swept across Europe today
headline.summary: Millions watched as totality crossed Greenland, Iceland and Spain — Spain's first total eclipse in over a century. Fittingly, it's on your calendar too, with the Perseids peaking tonight on a new moon.

forYou.text: YouTube's 2026 update adds new AI-content and kids guardrails alongside new revenue paths (YouTube Shopping now has 500K+ creators).
forYou.action: Check none of Clickster's AI-assisted edits trip the new disclosure rules — protect monetization before enforcement tightens.

forYou.text: Frontier AI got ~80% cheaper this month — GPT-5.6 dropped to $0.20/M tokens, with Claude 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 also out.
forYou.action: Cheap models = automate more of your pipeline: scripts, thumbnail concepts, even this dashboard. The cost floor just fell.

forYou.text: Creator income is shifting to owned audiences + direct offers; only ~4% earn $100K+ from ads alone (sector nearing $480B by 2027).
forYou.action: For internships, package your YouTube + this AI dashboard as proof you live at the creator × AI intersection.
